title: Automate insert and plugin parameters
description: Phase 3 shipped automation for track volume/pan/tone/reverb-send and master gain. AutoTarget::Insert(InsertTarget, insert id, param id) and AutoTarget::TrackPlugin(track id, param id) are already in the model, on the wire, pinned in ipc_contract.rs and round-trip tested, but sequence.rs lane_for resolves them to nothing and no UI creates one. Resolve them per sub-block and push values into the CLAP event buffer (crates/dissonant-plugins/src/host.rs, pre-sized for exactly this) and into native effect params once those exist. Offline render must honour them too.

title: Native insert effects: EQ, compressor, limiter, delay, saturation, reverb
description: A fresh machine has zero stock effects: per-track tone shaping is one low-pass, and on macOS the catalog's EQ and delay are kind:installer -> ManualInstallOnly, so an EQ cannot be installed from inside the app at all. The DSP already exists and is tested in crates/dissonant-engine/src/dsp.rs (Biquad family, Compressor, NoiseGate, Echo, Reverb::set_decay, TubeStage, Over2/Over4) but is reachable only from rig.rs on audio tracks. Add a native variant alongside InsertSlot::unit in channel.rs so the existing chain (8 per track plus master) can hold native effects, with params in the model, engine commands to set them, and UI in BottomPanel's InsertChain. Must render offline identically; render.rs drives the same Engine.
close_reason: Six stock effects (EQ, compressor, limiter, saturator, tempo-synced delay, reverb) in core/engine/tauri/UI. Native effects are Insert slots with uid native:<slug> and a serde(default) params map keyed by stable u32 ids in per-effect blocks of 100 (ready for AutoTarget::Insert in dis-vzh); no schema bump. InsertSlot::unit is now InsertUnit::{Plugin,Native}; run_inserts carries beat_seconds from the tempo map so the delay syncs in playback and in render.rs alike. New Command::SetInsertParam coalesces a knob drag into one undo step; BottomPanel's + effect lists the six first and the plugin knob column draws them unchanged. 15 new Rust tests + 6 UI tests, including a sample-for-sample bounce-equals-playback check. cargo clippy clean, tsc clean.

title: Insert and delete time (ripple), and sections that move the music
description: There is no InsertTime/DeleteTime command and no ripple anywhere, so 'the intro needs 4 more bars' means hand-dragging every clip on every track, every section marker, every tempo point and every chord, and cannot be one undo step. Section is {name,startTick,key,color} with no length, so dragging CHORUS in the arrangement relabels empty air while the music stays put. Add InsertTime/DeleteTime/DuplicateRange commands that shift clips, sections, tempo points and chords together, give sections an extent, and wire the arrangement ruler menu and the SETUP section panel to them.
close_reason: InsertTime/DeleteTime/DuplicateRange in core/src/ripple.rs (one undo step each, moving clips, audio takes, sections, tempo points, chords, automation, loop brace and song length; straddling material is split, never stretched), Section gained an extent (serde-default length_ticks, 0 = to the next marker) with section_span/section_at, mirrored in ui/src/{types,bridge}.ts, ruler right-click menu in Arrangement.tsx and duplicate/reorder in Setup's section panel. Rust tests in ripple.rs + document_behavior.rs section 10, TS tests in clipEditing/songSetup/bridge tests. cargo test --workspace green (bar the pre-existing audio-device test), clippy clean, tsc clean, 335 UI tests pass.
